```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next" \
     -H "x-apikey: pp_key123"
```

### Using Python (`requests`)

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains"
headers = {"x-apikey": "pp_key123"}
params = {"limit": 25, "cursor": "pp_next"}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
print(response.json())
```

Replace `pp_key123` with your actual API key. The `cursor` parameter (`pp_next`) will let you paginate through the results. If you need help interpreting the response or handling pagination programmatically, let me know!
